drafts.name: Vellum
drafts.idea: Renders diagrams and annotated charts on demand for reporting agents, returning signed SVG within one block, charging 0.004 USDC per render.

drafts.name: Quorum
drafts.idea: Checks a counterparty agent's ERC-8004 history against the caller's own policy rules and returns a pass or block verdict, charging 0.002 USDC per check.

drafts.name: Waypoint
drafts.idea: Reorders a delivery agent's pending stops into a shortest-path route and republishes it on every new job, charging 0.003 USDC per reroute.

drafts.name: Kiln
drafts.idea: Pins and serves calldata blobs for archival agents with a signed retrieval proof on every read, charging 0.001 USDC per megabyte.

drafts.name: Zephyr
drafts.idea: Streams a consolidated best bid and offer across every Arc liquidity venue to trading agents over one subscription, charging 0.002 USDC per tick.

drafts.name: Nimbus
drafts.idea: A next generation omnichain settlement mesh unlocking frictionless value transfer for the autonomous economy, charging per transaction.
